sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看您所用应用或我们网站上本集节目的说明。

sentences.en: The afternoon of Wednesday, September 5, 2012 was a pleasant one in Chervelines, a small wooded community located in the French Alps region of Haute-Savoie.
sentences.zh: 2012年9月5日，星期三，午后。谢尔韦利讷（Chervelines）的天气十分宜人，这是一个位于法国上萨瓦省阿尔卑斯山区的林间小社区。

sentences.en: Sharing nearby borders with Switzerland and Italy, the area is known for its mountain landscapes
sentences.zh: 该地区与瑞士和意大利接壤，以其山地景观而闻名，

sentences.en: and the medieval towns that dot Lake Annecy, a sparkling body of water considered to be the cleanest lake in Europe.
sentences.zh: 还有点缀在安纳西湖畔的中世纪小镇。安纳西湖是一片波光粼粼的水域，被认为是欧洲最洁净的湖泊。

sentences.en: In the warmer months, visitors from all over flock to the region to bask in the tranquil surroundings, swim in the clear waters, and enjoy everything that Lake Annecy has to offer.
sentences.zh: 在温暖的月份里，来自世界各地的游客蜂拥而至，沉浸在宁静的环境中，在清澈的湖水中游泳，尽情享受安纳西湖的一切。

sentences.en: British retiree Brett Martin had a holiday house not far from Chervelines.
sentences.zh: 英国退休人员布雷特·马丁在离谢尔韦利讷不远的地方有一座度假屋。

sentences.en: He took advantage of the sunny weather and took off on his mountain bike for a leisurely ride through the village of roughly 207 residents.
sentences.zh: 他趁着晴朗的天气，骑上山地自行车，悠闲地穿过这个约有207名居民的村庄。

sentences.en: He passed by the sprinkling of old country homes and pastures before the only thing on either side of him was woodland.
sentences.zh: 他经过了零星散布的古老乡村住宅和牧场，随后身旁两侧便只剩下林地了。

sentences.en: About ten minutes outside of Chervelines, Brett turned onto Cum Deer, a steep, uneven road that wound uphill through dense, sun-inhabited forests and past rushing streaMs.
sentences.zh: 在离开谢尔韦利讷约十分钟路程后，布雷特转入了一条名为“库姆鹿”（Cum Deer）的道路。这是一条陡峭且崎岖不平的土路，蜿蜒向上，穿过茂密、阳光稀疏的森林，经过湍急的溪流。

sentences.en: Brett had done the trip before.
sentences.zh: 布雷特以前走过这条路。

sentences.en: He knew that there were no other turn-offs until the three-kilometre mark when the public road gave way to a clearing called Le Martinet.
sentences.zh: 他知道在三公里处之前没有其他岔路口，到了那里，公共道路会变成一片名为“勒马蒂内”（Le Martinet）的空地。

sentences.en: This served as a small secluded parking area and was typically used as a starting point for visitors to explore the surrounding walking tracks and hiking trails.
sentences.zh: 这里是一个小型隐蔽的停车区，通常作为游客探索周边步道和徒步路线的起点。

sentences.en: It also signalled the end of the public road.
sentences.zh: 这也标志着公共道路的终点。

sentences.en: From Le Martinet, Cum Deer became a restricted route marked with a no-entry sign.
sentences.zh: 从勒马蒂内开始，库姆鹿路变成了一条设有禁止通行标志的限制路线。

sentences.en: Although hikers commonly used the route, the only vehicles with authorisation to access it were forestry workers.
sentences.zh: 虽然徒步旅行者经常使用这条路线，但唯一获准进入的车辆只有林业工人驾驶的车辆。

sentences.en: Brett powered on until Le Martinet clearing was in sight.
sentences.zh: 布雷特奋力骑行，直到勒马蒂内空地出现在视野中。

sentences.en: By this point, it was roughly 3.55pm.
sentences.zh: 此时大约是下午3点55分。

sentences.en: He looked ahead and noticed something in the middle of the road, a lightweight racing bicycle.
sentences.zh: 他向前看去，注意到路中间有什么东西——一辆轻便的赛车自行车。

sentences.en: Brett wondered why its owner would have left it there, but his thoughts were suddenly interrupted when a young, dark-haired girl stumbled out onto the road.
sentences.zh: 布雷特纳闷车主为何把它丢在那里，但他的思绪突然被打断了，因为一个年轻的黑发女孩跌跌撞撞地走到了路上。

sentences.en: She was covered in blood, her head and shoulder clearly injured.
sentences.zh: 她浑身是血，头部和肩膀明显受了伤。

sentences.en: Brett watched her sway from side to side before she collapsed face-first onto the ground.
sentences.zh: 布雷特看着她摇摇晃晃，随后一头栽倒在地上。

sentences.en: Brett rushed to the girl's aid.
sentences.zh: 布雷特冲过去救助那个女孩。

sentences.en: Her eyes were rolling around as though she was about to lose consciousness.
sentences.zh: 她的双眼不停地转动，仿佛即将失去知觉。

sentences.en: Brett was a former Royal Air Force pilot and he used his first aid knowledge to gently move the girl off the road and place her in the recovery position.
sentences.zh: 布雷特曾是一名英国皇家空军飞行员，他利用自己的急救知识，小心翼翼地将女孩移出路面，并让她保持侧卧复苏体位。

sentences.en: That's when he noticed a maroon BMW Series 5 station wagon stopped to the left of the parking area, facing the road.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他注意到一辆栗色的宝马5系旅行车停在停车区左侧，车头朝向路面。

sentences.en: The same vehicle had passed Brett just a few minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 几分钟前，同一辆车刚刚超过布雷特。

sentences.en: He'd remembered it because it had British licence plates and it was right-hand to drive.
sentences.zh: 他记得这辆车是因为它挂着英国车牌，而且是右舵驾驶。

sentences.en: Now its engine was revving as one of its rear wheels spun in a mound of gravel.
sentences.zh: 现在，它的引擎在轰鸣，其中一个后轮在一堆碎石中空转。

sentences.en: On the ground in front of the BMW, a middle-aged man was lying in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 在宝马车前的地面上，一名中年男子躺在血泊中。

sentences.en: Brett recognised the man as the owner of the discarded bicycle.
sentences.zh: 布雷特认出这名男子就是那辆被丢弃的自行车的主人。

sentences.en: The two had passed one another towards the start of Coom Deer.
sentences.zh: 两人在库姆鹿路起点附近曾擦肩而过。

sentences.en: Brett had initially tried to keep up with the other cyclist, but had given up and lingered back at his own pace.
sentences.zh: 布雷特起初试图跟上那名骑行者，但后来放弃了，放慢速度按自己的节奏骑行。

sentences.en: Thinking that the cyclist and car must have collided,
sentences.zh: 布雷特以为是骑行者和汽车发生了碰撞，

sentences.en: Brett's immediate thought was that the revving BMW could lurch forward at any moment and cause further injury to the cycliSt.
sentences.zh: 他脑海中闪过的第一个念头是，那辆轰鸣的宝马车随时可能向前冲出，对骑行者造成进一步伤害。

sentences.en: He rushed to move the man out of the way, only to realise that he hadn't been hit by the car at all.
sentences.zh: 他冲过去想把那名男子移开，却意识到他根本不是被车撞的。

sentences.en: He'd been shot multiple times in the head.
sentences.zh: 他的头部中了多枪。

sentences.en: Brett realised that the BMW's windows were riddled with bullet holes.
sentences.zh: 布雷特意识到宝马车的车窗上布满了弹孔。

sentences.en: He moved closer, only to see that the interior of the vehicle was covered with blood.
sentences.zh: 他走近一看，发现车内满是鲜血。

sentences.en: Inside, a middle-aged male was slumped over in the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 车内，一名中年男子瘫倒在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: In the back seat was a middle-aged woman with an elderly woman beside her.
sentences.zh: 后座上是一名中年女子，旁边还有一位老妇人。

sentences.en: All three had been shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 三人全都头部中弹。

sentences.en: Brett smashed the bullet-ridden driver's side window and reached in to turn off the ignition.
sentences.zh: 布雷特砸碎了布满弹孔的驾驶座车窗，伸手进去关掉了引擎。

sentences.en: He took out his mobile phone to call for help, but there was no reception.
sentences.zh: 他拿出手机呼救，但没有信号。

sentences.en: He faced a dilemma.
sentences.zh: 他面临着两难的抉择。

sentences.en: Did he leave the wounded girl there, or did he attempt to take her with him and risk worsening her injuries?
sentences.zh: 是把受伤的女孩留在那里，还是尝试带她一起走，冒着加重她伤势的风险？

sentences.en: Scared that the shooter was still in the area and could target him next,
sentences.zh: 担心枪手还在附近，可能会将他作为下一个目标，

sentences.en: Brett got back on his bike and rode for help, leaving the injured girl by the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 布雷特骑上自行车去寻求帮助，将受伤的女孩留在了路边。

sentences.en: Within minutes, Brett Martin encountered a car full of French hikers who were able to get a mobile signal and summon emergency services.
sentences.zh: 几分钟内，布雷特·马丁遇到了一辆载满法国徒步旅行者的汽车，他们能够接收到手机信号并呼叫了紧急救援服务。

sentences.en: Paramedics, rescue personnel and teams of police sped to the area.
sentences.zh: 医护人员、救援人员和警察队伍迅速赶往该地区。

sentences.en: The wounded girl was airlifted to hospital in a critical condition.
sentences.zh: 受伤的女孩被直升机送往医院，情况危急。

sentences.en: As doctors assessed her injuries, they realised that she'd received a gunshot wound to the shoulder before being brutally beaten in the head.
sentences.zh: 医生在评估她的伤势时发现，她在头部遭到残酷殴打之前，肩膀曾中过一枪。

sentences.en: Her orbital bone was fractured and her skull was cracked, resulting in a traumatic brain injury.
sentences.zh: 她的眼眶骨折，颅骨破裂，导致了创伤性脑损伤。

sentences.en: The girl was put into an induced coma while surgeons tried desperately to save her life.
sentences.zh: 女孩被置于药物诱导昏迷状态，外科医生们拼尽全力试图挽救她的生命。

sentences.en: But there was nothing to be done for the cyclist or those inside the BMW.
sentences.zh: 但对于那名骑行者和宝马车内的人来说，一切都已无力回天。

sentences.en: All four were pronounced dead at the scene.
sentences.zh: 四人均被当场宣布死亡。

sentences.en: A cursory search of the woods surrounding the crime scene was conducted, with the helicopter passing overhead.
sentences.zh: 警方对案发现场周围的树林进行了初步搜查，直升机在上方盘旋。

sentences.en: Nothing was found to indicate the shooter was still in the area.
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何迹象表明枪手仍在该地区。

sentences.en: Police at the scene decided it was best to wait for the specialist forensic team to arrive from Paris before examining the interior of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 现场警察决定，在检查车内情况之前，最好等待从巴黎赶来的专业法医团队。

sentences.en: The car windows were so badly cracked by bullet holes that a single movement could cause one to collapse, thus damaging crucial evidence.
sentences.zh: 车窗被弹孔震裂得非常严重，任何轻微的移动都可能导致车窗崩塌，从而破坏关键证据。

sentences.en: The deceased cyclist still had his wallet on him, which led to him being identified as 45-year-old Sylvain Molière.
sentences.zh: 死去的骑行者身上仍带着钱包，这使他被确认为45岁的西尔万·莫里埃。

sentences.en: The quiet and reserved father of three lived just 20 kilometres east of Chauveline, in the small town of Ougène.
sentences.zh: 这位沉默寡言、内向的三个孩子的父亲住在距离谢尔韦利讷以东仅20公里的小镇乌热讷。

sentences.en: Sylvain's partner, Claire, had recently given birth to a baby boy.
sentences.zh: 西尔万的伴侣克莱尔最近刚生下一个男婴。

sentences.en: A dedicated father, Sylvain had taken extended paternity leave from his job as a production worker to take care of his young son and two teenage children from a previous marriage.
sentences.zh: 作为一名尽职尽责的父亲，西尔万从生产工人的工作中申请了延长的陪产假，以照顾年幼的儿子以及他与前妻所生的两个十几岁的孩子。

sentences.en: Sylvain was a keen cyclist who enjoyed riding the local trails.
sentences.zh: 西尔万是一位热衷于骑行的爱好者，喜欢在当地的小径上骑车。

sentences.en: That afternoon, he'd wanted to try a new route, so he headed up the Qumdir Road at the recommendation of Claire's father.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，他想尝试一条新路线，于是听从了克莱尔父亲的建议，沿着库姆鹿路向上骑行。

sentences.en: The British-registered BMW was traced back to Le Solitaire du Lac, a campsite roughly 14 kilometres north of Qumdir.
sentences.zh: 那辆英国牌照的宝马车被追溯到“勒索利泰尔湖”（Le Solitaire du Lac）露营地，该营地位于库姆鹿以北约14公里处。

sentences.en: The occupants of the BMW were identified as 50-year-old Saad al-Hili, an Iraqi-born British citizen who lived in the English village of Claygate.
sentences.zh: 宝马车内的乘客被确认为50岁的萨阿德·阿尔-希利，一名出生于伊拉克的英国公民，住在英国的克莱盖特村。

sentences.en: The two women in the back seat were his wife, 47-year-old Iraqi-born Iqbal al-Hili, and Iqbal's 74-year-old mother, Suheila al-Alaf.
sentences.zh: 后座上的两名女性分别是他的妻子，47岁的伊拉克裔英国人伊克巴尔·阿尔-希利，以及伊克巴尔74岁的母亲苏海拉·阿尔-阿拉夫。

sentences.en: The injured girl was the couple's seven-year-old daughter, Zainab.
sentences.zh: 受伤的女孩是这对夫妇七岁的女儿扎伊纳布。

sentences.en: A caravan registered to Saad al-Hili remained exactly where the family had left it, parked alongside their tent.
sentences.zh: 一辆登记在萨阿德·阿尔-希利名下的房车仍停在他们离开时的原处，停在帐篷旁边。

sentences.en: The owner of the campsite told the police that the Al-Hili family had checked in the previous day of Tuesday, September 4.
sentences.zh: 露营地老板告诉警方，阿尔-希利一家是在前一天，即9月4日星期二登记入住的。

sentences.en: They'd actually arrived in the area on Saturday, but had stayed at a different campsite for two nights before moving to Le Solitaire du Lac.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上周六就到达了该地区，但在搬到勒索利泰尔湖之前，在另一个露营地住了两晚。

sentences.en: The owner recalled nothing unusual about the family's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 老板回忆说，这家人表现得并无异常。

sentences.en: Saad had asked about good walking trails in the area, to which the owner had recommended the general area around Cherveline, but hadn't signalled out a specific location.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德曾询问过该地区好的徒步路线，老板向他推荐了谢尔韦利讷周边的大致区域，但并没有特别指出某个具体地点。

sentences.en: Other guests told the police that the Al-Hili seemed like an ordinary family on vacation.
sentences.zh: 其他住客告诉警方，阿尔-希利一家看起来就像普通的度假家庭。

sentences.en: The guests who were camping next to them recalled the two little girls playing happily.
sentences.zh: 住在他们隔壁露营的住客回忆说，两个小女孩玩得很开心。

sentences.en: When the questioning officers heard this, they froze.
sentences.zh: 当负责询问的警官听到这里时，他们愣住了。

sentences.en: Two little girls.
sentences.zh: 两个小女孩。

sentences.en: There had only been one young girl found at the crime scene, seven-year-old Zainab.
sentences.zh: 案发现场只发现了一个小女孩，即七岁的扎伊纳布。

sentences.en: There was only one child seat inside the BMW, so investigators hadn't even thought to check the vehicle for a second child.
sentences.zh: 宝马车内只有一个儿童座椅，所以调查人员甚至没想过要在车里寻找第二个孩子。

sentences.en: Cursory searches of the area hadn't revealed any sign of another victim.
sentences.zh: 对该地区的初步搜查也没有发现任何其他受害者的迹象。

sentences.en: This left two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 这留下了两种可能性。

sentences.en: Either the second Al-Hili daughter had run into the woods to escape the shooter and was still out there somewhere, or she'd been abducted.
sentences.zh: 要么是阿尔-希利的第二个女儿跑进树林躲避枪手，现在还在外面某处；要么就是她被绑架了。

sentences.en: By this point, it was nearing midnight.
sentences.zh: 此时已近午夜。

sentences.en: Authorities had been gathered at the crime scene for close to eight hours.
sentences.zh: 当局在案发现场聚集了近八个小时。

sentences.en: The specialist forensic team had just arrived from Paris, and one officer finally opened the back door of the BMW.
sentences.zh: 来自巴黎的专业法医团队刚刚抵达，一名警官终于打开了宝马车的后门。

sentences.en: There, cowering silently underneath Iqbal Al-Hili's skirt, was her four-year-old daughter, Zina.
sentences.zh: 在那里，蜷缩在伊克巴尔·阿尔-希利裙子下瑟瑟发抖的，是她四岁的女儿齐娜。

sentences.en: The young girl was terrified, but unharmed.
sentences.zh: 小女孩被吓坏了，但没有受伤。

sentences.en: For eight hours, she'd been frozen in fear, unable to grasp the carnage that had taken place around her.
sentences.zh: 八个小时来，她一直因恐惧而僵住，无法理解周围发生的惨剧。

sentences.en: Smiling with relief at finally being found, Zina looked up and said,
sentences.zh: 齐娜终于获救，露出了释然的微笑，她抬头说道：

sentences.en: Where's mummy?
sentences.zh: “妈妈在哪儿？”

sentences.en: I want my mummy.
sentences.zh: “我想找我妈妈。”

sentences.en: At no point during the attack had Zina exited the car, so she couldn't tell the investigators much.
sentences.zh: 在袭击过程中，齐娜从未离开过车，所以她无法向调查人员提供太多信息。

sentences.en: All she remembered was hearing loud noises before quickly hiding on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她只记得听到巨大的响声，然后迅速躲到了地板上。

sentences.en: Investigators hoped her older sister would be more helpful, but whether Zainab would recover remained to be seen.
sentences.zh: 调查人员希望她的姐姐能提供更多帮助，但扎伊纳布能否康复还有待观察。

sentences.en: In the meantime, the priority remained on catching the killer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，首要任务仍然是抓住凶手。

sentences.en: If the shooting was a random attack conducted by a deranged individual, a quick arrest was needed to stop them from striking again.
sentences.zh: 如果这起枪击案是一个精神错乱者实施的随机袭击，那么必须尽快将其逮捕，以防他们再次行凶。

sentences.en: The deceased inside the BMW were still in possession of their wallets, mobile phones, and a digital camera.
sentences.zh: 宝马车内的死者身上仍带着钱包、手机和一台数码相机。

sentences.en: This ruled out robbery as a motive for the killings.
sentences.zh: 这排除了抢劫作为杀人动机的可能性。

sentences.en: But, strangely, their passports were nowhere to be found either in their car or at their campsite.
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，他们的护照在车里和露营地都找不到了。

sentences.en: A forensic search for fingerprints, DNA, or any other clues came up empty.
sentences.zh: 对指纹、DNA或其他线索的法医搜查一无所获。

sentences.en: All the police had to go by were the spent bullet casings, 21 of which were found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 警方唯一能利用的线索是弹壳，现场共发现了21枚。

sentences.en: Using the ballistics and limited physical evidence, investigators deduced that after arriving at Le Martinet,
sentences.zh: 通过弹道分析和有限的物证，调查人员推断，在到达勒马蒂内后，

sentences.en: Saad and seven-year-old Zainab likely got out of the car, perhaps to examine a map of the area that was posted to the side of the parking spot.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德和七岁的扎伊纳布可能下了车，也许是为了查看贴在停车位旁边的区域地图。

sentences.en: At the same time, Sylvain Moliere cycled up.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，西尔万·莫里埃骑车赶到。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to all of them, the shooter was hiding nearby, likely in a nearby gully or the surrounding trees.
sentences.zh: 他们所有人都不知道，枪手就躲在附近，很可能是在附近的一条沟壑或周围的树丛中。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the shots began.
sentences.zh: 突然，枪声响起。

sentences.en: It was unclear who was shot first, but one bullet struck Saad in the back, while another knocked Sylvain to the ground.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚谁先中枪，但一颗子弹击中了萨阿德的背部，另一颗将西尔万击倒在地。

sentences.en: Saad then ran back to his BMW, yelling at little Zainab to do the same.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德随后跑回宝马车，大声叫喊让小扎伊纳布也这样做。

sentences.en: Slamming and locking the door, he reversed in a semicircle direction, trying desperately to escape the onslaught.
sentences.zh: 他猛地关上并锁好车门，半圆弧状倒车，拼命试图逃离这场屠杀。

sentences.en: In the process, he clipped Sylvain Moliere.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，他撞到了西尔万·莫里埃。

sentences.en: Saad's rear tyre got stuck in a mound of dirt, leaving his family stranded.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德的后轮胎陷进了一堆泥土里，导致他的家人被困住。

sentences.en: The shooter then approached the vehicle from their hiding place.
sentences.zh: 枪手随后从藏身处靠近车辆。

sentences.en: With careful, callous precision, they shot Saad, Iqbal and Suheila through the side windows.
sentences.zh: 他们以小心、冷酷的精准度，透过侧窗射杀了萨阿德、伊克巴尔和苏海拉。

sentences.en: Both Saad and Iqbal were shot four times, while Suheila sustained three gunshots.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德和伊克巴尔各中四枪，苏海拉中了三枪。

sentences.en: All three of them were shot twice directly in the middle of the forehead.
sentences.zh: 他们三人全都头部中了两枪，子弹直接击中前额正中。

sentences.en: The killer then returned their attention to Sylvain Moliere, pulling the trigger four more times.
sentences.zh: 凶手随后将注意力转回西尔万·莫里埃身上，又扣动了四次扳机。

sentences.en: They stood over his body, shooting him execution style directly between the eyes.
sentences.zh: 他们站在他的尸体上方，以行刑方式直接对着他的双眼之间开枪。

sentences.en: Investigators weren't sure at what point seven-year-old Zainab was shot.
sentences.zh: 调查人员不确定七岁的扎伊纳布是在什么时候中枪的。

sentences.en: Judging by the injuries to her head, the killer had likely either run out of bullets or their gun had jammed before they were able to finish what they started.
sentences.zh: 从她头部的伤势来看，凶手很可能是在完成行凶前子弹耗尽，或者枪支卡壳了。

sentences.en: Instead, they used the barrel of the gun to bash the child over the head.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们用枪管猛击孩子的头部。

sentences.en: The entire ambush likely lasted less than 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 整场伏击可能持续了不到60秒。

sentences.en: Of the 21 shots fired during that time,
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里发射的21发子弹中，

sentences.en: 17 of them had hit the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 有17发击中了受害者。

sentences.en: In the attack on Zainab, a piece of grip from the gun handle had broken off.
sentences.zh: 在袭击扎伊纳布时，枪柄上的一块握把碎片脱落了。

sentences.en: Coupled with the bullet casings, this allowed investigators to identify the murder weapon as a semi-automatic Luger P-06.
sentences.zh: 结合弹壳，这使得调查人员确定凶器为一支鲁格P-06半自动手枪。

sentences.en: The Swiss model service pistol had been a standard issue to members of the Swiss Army and police in the 1920s and 30s.
sentences.zh: 这种瑞士型号的制式手枪在20世纪20年代和30年代是瑞士军队和警察的标准装备。

sentences.en: It was an odd choice for a shooting spree.
sentences.zh: 这对于一场枪击狂潮来说是一个奇怪的选择。

sentences.en: The kind of gun more likely to be found in a museum or private collection rather than used to commit a brutal crime.
sentences.zh: 这种枪更像是出现在博物馆或私人收藏中，而不是用来犯下如此残忍的罪行。

sentences.en: Despite its age, it was still considered to be an incredibly accurate and reliable weapon, allowing up to 48 shots to be fired in under 30 seconds.
sentences.zh: 尽管年代久远，它仍被认为是一种极其精准且可靠的武器，能在30秒内发射多达48发子弹。

sentences.en: Only eight cartridges could be loaded at once.
sentences.zh: 一次只能装填8发子弹。

sentences.en: With 21 shots fired, this meant that the Le Martinet shooter had reloaded twice during the attack.
sentences.zh: 发射了21发子弹，这意味着勒马蒂内的枪手在袭击过程中重新装填了两次。

sentences.en: Given that they'd managed to do so while hitting all of their targets and without hitting the body of the moving BMW, police were certain of one thing.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们能在击中所有目标的同时完成装填，且没有击中移动中的宝马车身，警方确信一点。

sentences.en: Whoever was responsible was an experienced and skilled shooter who fully intended to hit each one of their victiMs.
sentences.zh: 无论谁是幕后黑手，都是一名经验丰富且技术娴熟的枪手，完全打算击中每一位受害者。

sentences.en: News of the slaying spread throughout the Annecy region where violent crimes were mostly unheard of.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案的消息传遍了安纳西地区，那里几乎从未发生过暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: Cherveline and its surroundings were considered incredibly safe, the type of place where residents didn't bother to lock their doors.
sentences.zh: 谢尔韦利讷及其周边地区被认为极其安全，是那种居民连门都不锁的地方。

sentences.en: There were only 70 homes in Cherveline, making it easy for police to question every household.
sentences.zh: 谢尔韦利讷只有70户人家，这使得警方很容易询问每一户家庭。

sentences.en: Other than Brett Martin, nobody had witnessed anything that could be of use to the investigation or had suspicions about who the perpetrator might be,
sentences.zh: 除了布雷特·马丁之外，没有人目击到任何对调查有用的情况，也没有人怀疑肇事者可能是谁，

sentences.en: except for a trio of forestry workers.
sentences.zh: 除了三名林业工人。

sentences.en: As reported exclusively by BBC's Panorama program, one forestry worker was driving down Cum Deer Road shortly before the shootings when they passed Le Martinet parking area.
sentences.zh: 据英国广播公司（BBC）《全景》节目独家报道，一名林业工人在枪击案发生前不久开车沿库姆鹿路行驶，经过了勒马蒂内停车区。

sentences.en: To the left of the clearing, they saw a large motorcycle pulled over on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 在空地的左侧，他们看到一辆大型摩托车停在路边。

sentences.en: It was black and white, with panniers on the side.
sentences.zh: 那是黑白相间的，侧面带有行李箱。

sentences.en: The driver was dressed all in black, including a distinct dark helmet with a visor that was pulled down, covering their face completely.
sentences.zh: 驾驶员全身穿着黑色，包括一顶独特的深色头盔，面罩拉下，完全遮住了脸。

sentences.en: As the forestry worker continued down the public portion of the road, they soon passed another vehicle, a metallic grey BMW four-wheel drive.
sentences.zh: 当林业工人继续沿着公路的公共路段行驶时，他们很快经过了另一辆车，那是一辆金属灰色的宝马四驱车。

sentences.en: They believed it to be British, as it was right-hand drive.
sentences.zh: 他们认为那是英国车，因为它是右舵驾驶的。

sentences.en: The car was in good, clean condition and it was being driven by a slightly balding male with dark skin.
sentences.zh: 这辆车状况良好且干净，驾驶者是一名略微秃顶、皮肤黝黑的男性。

sentences.en: The forestry worker was taken aback by how fast the car was driving on the narrow road.
sentences.zh: 林业工人对这辆车在狭窄道路上行驶的速度之快感到吃惊。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, two other forestry workers were coming down the restricted road above Le Martinet when they too crossed paths with the large black and white motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，另外两名林业工人正沿着勒马蒂内上方的限制通行道路行驶，他们也与那辆黑白相间的大型摩托车擦肩而过。

sentences.en: Given that public vehicles were forbidden from entering this section of the road, they waved the motorcyclist down.
sentences.zh: 鉴于禁止公共车辆进入该路段，他们挥手示意摩托车手停下。

sentences.en: The rider's helmet was distinct in that it had a hinged visor that could be opened sideways to allow the wearer to hold a conversation without having to remove their helmet.
sentences.zh: 骑手的头盔很特别，带有一个铰链式面罩，可以向侧面打开，让佩戴者无需摘下头盔就能进行交谈。

sentences.en: The rider pulled the visor across, revealing he was a white male with a goatee and heavy brow.
sentences.zh: 骑手拉开面罩，露出了一张长着山羊胡、眉骨突出的白人男性的脸。

sentences.en: He said nothing as the forestry workers told him to turn around and drive back down.
sentences.zh: 当林业工人让他掉头往回开时，他一言不发。

sentences.en: Brett Martin, the cyclist who discovered the bodies, had also seen this motorcycle coming down the Coom Deer Road as he struggled up the hill just before 3.55pm.
sentences.zh: 发现尸体的骑行者布雷特·马丁在下午3点55分前奋力爬坡时，也曾看到这辆摩托车从库姆鹿路下来。

sentences.en: Brett didn't recall seeing the metallic grey BMW, but he did have a vague recollection of a large four-wheel drive passing him at some point along his journey.
sentences.zh: 布雷特不记得见过那辆金属灰色的宝马，但他模糊地记得在旅途中的某个时刻，有一辆大型四驱车超过了他。

sentences.en: Based on these timings, it was deduced that Brett had stumbled upon the crime scene within a mere minute of the shootings.
sentences.zh: 根据这些时间点推断，布雷特在枪击发生后仅仅一分钟内就偶然闯入了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: He hadn't heard any of the gunshots because the sound had been masked by the white noise of the rushing river.
sentences.zh: 他没有听到任何枪声，因为声音被湍急河流的白噪音掩盖了。

sentences.en: The only people who had heard the shots were a local father and son, but they hadn't given it much thought.
sentences.zh: 唯一听到枪声的是当地的一对父子，但他们当时没多想。

sentences.en: Hunting season was coming up, so they just assumed hunters were out testing their rifles.
sentences.zh: 狩猎季节快到了，所以他们只是以为有猎人在外面试枪。

sentences.en: Neither Brett nor the trio of French hikers who arrived at the scene shortly after the shooting recalled seeing anyone past them down the hill.
sentences.zh: 布雷特和枪击发生后不久到达现场的三名法国徒步旅行者，都不记得看到有人从他们下方的山坡经过。

sentences.en: This presented two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 这引出了两种可能性。

sentences.en: Either the man on the motorcycle was the killer and he'd brazenly fled via the public road even after knowing he'd been spotted in the area, or the killer was someone else entirely
sentences.zh: 要么骑摩托车的男子就是凶手，他在明知自己被发现的情况下，依然厚颜无耻地从公共道路逃离；要么凶手另有其人，

sentences.en: and they'd fled via the woods, or the restricted route just around the bend from Le Martinet.
sentences.zh: 他们从树林逃走，或者从勒马蒂内拐角处的限制通行路线逃离。

sentences.en: Although the rough, narrow road was clearly marked with a no-entry sign, it was still easily accessible.
sentences.zh: 尽管这条崎岖狭窄的道路上有明显的禁止通行标志，但依然很容易进入。

sentences.en: A person on foot, motorcycle, bike, or four-wheel drive could have made their way down the rugged terrain to the other side of the mountain within an hour.
sentences.zh: 无论是步行、骑摩托车、骑自行车还是开四驱车的人，都可以在一小时内穿过崎岖的地形到达山的另一侧。

sentences.en: Even a regular car could have made the journey if the driver was willing to accept pothole damage to their vehicle.
sentences.zh: 即使是普通汽车，如果司机愿意接受车辆被坑洼损坏的后果，也能完成这段旅程。

sentences.en: From there, there were plenty of possible escape routes with Italy and Switzerland just a short distance away.
sentences.zh: 从那里出发，有许多可能的逃跑路线，距离意大利和瑞士都只有很短的路程。

sentences.en: Police considered whether the motorcyclist could have been working in conjunction with the metallic grey four-wheel drive.
sentences.zh: 警方考虑了摩托车手是否可能与那辆金属灰色四驱车协同作案。

sentences.en: A suspect sketch was drawn up based on the forestry worker's recollection, but police decided to withhold the image out of fear that it could spook the motorcyclist
sentences.zh: 警方根据林业工人的回忆绘制了一张嫌疑人素描，但决定不公布这张图片，担心这会惊动摩托车手，

sentences.en: and send him on the run.
sentences.zh: 并导致他潜逃。

sentences.en: Less than 48 hours after the shooting, the crime scene was teeming with local and international media.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生不到48小时，犯罪现场就挤满了当地和国际媒体。

sentences.en: This was a major news story and the public were hungry for information.
sentences.zh: 这是一则重大新闻，公众渴望获取信息。

sentences.en: Local police had been sworn to silence and the only individual involved with the French investigation who was allowed to speak publicly about the case
sentences.zh: 当地警方被要求保持沉默，而法国调查组中唯一获准公开谈论此案的人，

sentences.en: was Annecy prosecutor Eric Mayour.
sentences.zh: 是安纳西检察官埃里克·梅约。

sentences.en: Mayour confirmed to the press that the police were working hard to determine a motive.
sentences.zh: 梅约向媒体证实，警方正在努力确定动机。

sentences.en: All they knew for certain was that, quote, it was clearly an act of extreme savagery and it was obvious that who did this wanted to kill.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一能确定的是，引用他的话：“这显然是一种极度野蛮的行为，很明显，作案者就是想要杀人。”

sentences.en: The French president vowed that everything would be done to find the person responsible.
sentences.zh: 法国总统誓言将竭尽全力找到责任人。

sentences.en: Given that the crime was committed on French soil against British citizens,
sentences.zh: 鉴于犯罪发生在法国领土上，受害者是英国公民，

sentences.en: French authorities joined investigators from the UK to try and answer the prevailing question.
sentences.zh: 法国当局与英国调查人员联手，试图回答那个核心问题。

sentences.en: Was this a random attack or did someone want the Alhilly family dead?
sentences.zh: 这是一次随机袭击，还是有人想要阿尔希利一家死？

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: For Saad al-Hilly, one of life's greatest pleasures was spending quality time with his family.
sentences.zh: 对于萨阿德·阿尔希利来说，人生最大的乐趣之一就是与家人共度美好时光。

sentences.en: He'd met his wife Iqbal nine years prior in Abu Dhabi, where Iqbal had been living at the time.
sentences.zh: 九年前，他在阿布扎比遇到了妻子伊克巴尔，当时伊克巴尔就住在那里。

sentences.en: They married quickly and moved into Saad's childhood home in the British village of Claygate, where they settled down to raise a family.
sentences.zh: 他们很快结婚，并搬进了萨阿德在英国克莱盖特村的老家，在那里定居并组建家庭。

sentences.en: Iqbal put her career as a dentist on hold to be a stay-at-home mum to their two young daughters.
sentences.zh: 伊克巴尔暂停了牙医的职业生涯，成为了一名全职妈妈，照顾他们两个年幼的女儿。

sentences.en: The trip to the French Alps had been a spur-of-the-moment decision.
sentences.zh: 这次法国阿尔卑斯山之行是一个突如其来的决定。

sentences.en: Saad had business to tend to in the Swiss city of Geneva, which was just across the border from Annecy.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德在瑞士日内瓦有生意要处理，那里就在安纳西边境对面。

sentences.en: Even though Zainab and Zena were due to return to school after summer holidays,
sentences.zh: 尽管扎伊娜布和泽娜暑假后就要开学了，

sentences.en: Saad recognised it as an opportunity for a short family getaway.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德还是认为这是一个全家短途旅行的好机会。

sentences.en: He adored France and had stayed in the Alps region a few times before.
sentences.zh: 他热爱法国，之前曾几次去过阿尔卑斯地区。

sentences.en: It also gave him an opportunity to take his beloved caravan out on the road.
sentences.zh: 这也让他有机会开着他心爱的房车上路。

sentences.en: Saad worked as a freelance engineer and he had a hobby for tinkering with mechanical parts.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德是一名自由工程师，他有一个爱好，就是摆弄机械零件。

sentences.en: He'd developed a passion for caravanning after he restored a damaged caravan to its former glory.
sentences.zh: 在修复了一辆受损的房车并使其恢复往日风采后，他对房车旅行产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: He'd since purchased a new one and jumped at any chance to use it.
sentences.zh: 此后他又买了一辆新的，只要有机会就会开出去。

sentences.en: Sometimes he'd take his family to stay at the local campsite just 10 miles from their home just to enjoy a change of scenery.
sentences.zh: 有时他会带家人去离家仅10英里的当地露营地，只是为了换个环境享受生活。

sentences.en: The family invited
sentences.zh: 这家人邀请了

sentences.en: Iqbal's mother,
sentences.zh: 伊克巴尔的母亲，

sentences.en: Suheila Al-Alaf, to join them on their last-minute
sentences.zh: 苏海拉·阿拉夫，加入他们这次临时起意的

sentences.en: French getaway.
sentences.zh: 法国之旅。

sentences.en: The 74-year-old lived in Sweden but was staying with her other daughter who lived an hour away from the Al-Hillies in southern England.
sentences.zh: 这位74岁的老人住在瑞典，但当时正和住在英格兰南部、离阿尔希利家一小时路程的另一个女儿住在一起。

sentences.en: Once word got out that the victims lived in Claygate, the media attention in Britain was immense.
sentences.zh: 当受害者住在克莱盖特的消息传出后，英国媒体的关注度极高。

sentences.en: Claygate was an affluent, family-oriented suburb
sentences.zh: 克莱盖特是一个富裕的、以家庭为中心的郊区，

sentences.en: 14 miles south-west of London.
sentences.zh: 位于伦敦西南14英里处。

sentences.en: A local family being the targets of an international shooting was sensational news.
sentences.zh: 当地一个家庭成为国际枪击案的目标，这可是轰动新闻。

sentences.en: Both of Saad's parents had passed away in recent years but reporters gathered outside the flat of his only sibling, older brother
sentences.zh: 萨阿德的父母近年来都已去世，但记者们聚集在他唯一的亲人、哥哥

sentences.en: Zaid Al-Hillie.
sentences.zh: 扎伊德·阿尔希利的公寓外。

sentences.en: Zaid couldn't think of anyone who would want to harm
sentences.zh: 扎伊德想不出有谁会想要伤害

sentences.en: Saad or his family.
sentences.zh: 萨阿德或他的家人。

sentences.en: Likewise, other friends of the family confirmed there was nothing untoward in the Al-Hillie household.
